unknown_and_filter_semantics.unknown_scalar: null; do not interpret as zero, false, ineligible or not-applicable
unknown_and_filter_semantics.unknown_list: [] only where no applicable items were established; for an eligibility filter, absence from a list does not prove ineligibility
unknown_and_filter_semantics.age_and_income: Only evaluate against a known bound or limit. Unknown bounds must return unknown.
unknown_and_filter_semantics.state: Records apply across India unless scheme-specific jurisdiction narrows it; MP state records use Madhya Pradesh.

public_verification_badges: Not part of the application dataset. Evidence and completeness are internal audit metadata.
